noOrdinaryUser: Cloud Spanner is a hosted service with one login for this work, a service account that holds roles/spanner.databaseAdmin on one database and no instance-level role. dbrun makes no ordinary user for it. The recordings are of that one login.

entries.absent: The emulator checks no credential. A request with no Authorization header, or with any token, gets the same answer, so there is no failed authentication to record (docs/SPANNER.md, The emulator).
